name: Spot the pattern
goal: Send a 1 to the bin every time the last three bits were 1, 0, 1 — counting matches that share a bit. Everywhere else, a 0. Three things to tell apart, and two registers to tell them apart with.
hint: you are being asked about three bits at once, and only one of them is still arriving. What has to be kept is the answer to a smaller question about the other two.
